purpose: Understand the wait for a voice response. Generating audio and hearing it are separate measurements.
method: Actual production playback backing with native48k mono microphone observation under paced native Parakeet-v3 decoder load. Threshold-qualified arrival, not human perception or full-turn latency.
findings: 30/30 warm pickups qualified. Complete threshold-qualified microphone median accepted for this route/workload; default promotion remains a separate contract.
